verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of David. Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of David. Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of David.

verses.html: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.text: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.html: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.text: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

verses.html: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.text: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

verses.html: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.text: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

verses.html: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.text: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

verses.html: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.text: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.html: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.html: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

verses.html: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.text: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

verses.html: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.html: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.html: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
